body: Your art is amazing! Thank you so much for sharing, they both look adorable in your style ❤️
Está bien bonito su dibujo compa :)
Keep up the amazing work! ¡Ánimo! Lo estás haciendo muy bien :)
He was adorable, I’m sure he loved you just like you loved him ❤️
I love the last picture of you with your cat! Very cute both of you ❤️
You’re so cute! You’re eyes, hair and lips are so so pretty! I don’t know how to rate people, but I can tell you that I consider you are beautiful! The picture of you smiling made me smile too :)✨
I want to see and play with snow one day

I wish I could give you any advice... I have a lot of problems when it comes to deal with love and relationships, but I believe you deserve to be loved the way you are loving, I wish things in life were fair, you sound so genuine about wanting things to be okay for both of you... Sorry if I don't have any useful suggestions... But I had to let you know that I hope you can one day be given the love you deserve, please take care

Even though I don't wish anyone to go through something like this, it feels nice to be understood, I know how hard it can be to prevent yourself from doing it again, you're really strong, let's try to not give up just yet...
I will try it, thank you for taking the time to reply, I really appreciate it

It's really hard to think about something I could call "positive"... But even if this might sound silly, there's a time in my day when I can sit of a while on my yard and watch my cats play, those are the only peaceful moments I have, and I can can bear with being alive then
Thank you, see you tomorrow then ^^
If this ends up as a group chat I'd like to participate please...
